title: SwarmOS
tagline: Simplify on-chain Interactions by using AI Agents - transactions, swapping, fetching information, trading, NFTs etc
description:
We Simplify on-chain Interactions by using AI Agents

User can connect their Base Wallet and directly run queries to run operations like:
- Fetching Balances of Anyone
- Fetching and understanding Last few transactions
- Using TheGraph to find liqudity, pools, transactions, etc related information regarding UniSwap
- DeFi, Morpho, Pyth, Social, Superfluid, WoW integrations
- Deploying Contracts, NFTs, Tokens
- Request Faucet Funds
- Mint NFTs
- Perform DeFI actions
how_its_made:
We extensively used AgentKit (Coinbase) and extended it's ability and raised OpenSourced PRs to add following things:
- Getting Anyone's Balances instead of just the system's balance.
- Added The Graph x uniswap v3 integration.
- Fetching information regarding past Transactions performed. 

Then we created a vite-react app to create a portal where user can connect their coinbase wallet (or even fund) and then directly perform the queries there itself.
